title: AnalyticsReply
description: Kafka Request-Reply response schema published by MS3 to topic analytics.reply

replyId.description: Unique UUID identifying this reply message

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier matching the original request's correlationId and header

sprintId.description: Target sprint identifier for the computed metrics

status.description: Execution status of the analytics computation

errorMessage.description: Error details if status is FAILED, otherwise null

totalPoints.description: Total committed story points in the sprint

velocity.description: Calculated or historical rolling velocity metric

healthScore.description: Composite health score from 0 (critical risk) to 100 (optimal)

burndownData.description: Timeline of daily burndown trajectory data points

date.description: Calendar date for the sprint day (YYYY-MM-DD)

dayIndex.description: 0-based day index within the sprint duration

completedOnDay.description: Story points transitioned to DONE on this specific day

diagnostics.description: List of diagnostic observations or warnings (e.g. Scope Creep, Velocity Deficit)
